Join us for a practical walkthrough of Clever’s newest features that help you secure and unify digital identities across all your apps - at no extra cost.
- [Clever at Bett UK 2025](https://www.clever.com/clever-at-bett-uk-2025) - Visit our booth at Bett UK 2025 in London to learn how to streamline protecting accounts and access at your school group!
- [Cybersecure Live](https://www.clever.com/cybersecure-live-2024) - Building a strong defense for your school community. Get practical advice from experts and explore the latest tools to build a layered approach to cybersecurity.
- [Building with Purpose - Lessons on Product Inclusion](https://www.clever.com/building-with-purpose-1) - Learn how product leaders from BrainPOP, GoGuardian, Seesaw, and Digital Promise approach making products that work better for all students.
- [New from Clever 2024 - Elevating Classroom Cybersecurity](https://www.clever.com/q1-NewfromClever-2024) - Learn about Clever's newest products and updates for school districts, including Classroom MFA and Clever LMS Connect.
- [New from Clever 2024 - Elevating Interoperability](https://www.clever.com/new-from-clever-2024-partners) - Application partners: Get the latest on Clever LMS Connect, get access to demographic data, and learn about our newest release: Classroom MFA.
- [How Clever districts are tightening up cybersecurity with Clever IDM and Clever MFA+](https://www.clever.com/blog/webinar-cleveridm-clevermfa) - Hear from fellow school IT leaders about their implementations of Clever tools like Clever IDM and Clever MFA+ to enhance security while streamlining access.
- [Charting the Course: Partner Product Talk](https://www.clever.com/blog/2023/10/q2-partner-product-talk) - Be the first to learn about our highly-anticipated new LMS product coming in 2024.
- [District Admins: Back to School 2023](https://www.clever.com/blog/webinar-back-to-school-district-2023) - Learn the key steps to prepare your schools for success, and product improvements that simplify your workflow.
- [Connecting to EBSCO Library resources through Clever SSO](https://www.clever.com/blog/webinar-connecting-to-ebsco/) - Learn about tips and useful resources on how students can use Clever to access EBSCO’s online research content and search technologies.
- [Teachers! Back to School 2023 Webinar](https://www.clever.com/blog/teachers-back-to-school-2023) - Learn how Clever works and the magic ways it can support you and your students in the classroom.
- [School Tech Leads! Back to School 2023 Webinar](https://www.clever.com/blog/stl-bts-webinar-2023) - Learn about Clever School Tech Lead tools and best practices that you can use to help teachers and students save classroom time.
- [Q2 Partner Product Talk](https://www.clever.com/events/q2-partner-product-talk) - Join us for our second partner product talk of 2023 to hear all about what's coming in Clever
- [Supercharge your cybersecurity efforts in 2023](https://www.clever.com/events/supercharge-your-cybersecurity-efforts) - How can teachers and administrators work together with tech leaders to protect sensitive data in 2023?
- [New from Clever 2023 - Applications](https://www.clever.com/events/new-from-clever-2023-applications) - Digital learning should just work - and we believe that with our partners we can advance education with technology that works for students everywhere.
- [New from Clever 2023 - Districts](https://www.clever.com/events/new-from-clever-2023-districts) - Digital learning should just work - and we believe that with some behind the scenes magic, i
- [Clever Cybersecure Week 2023](https://www.clever.com/events/clever-cybersecure-week-2023) - Calling all K-12 cybersecurity champions—join us for a weeklong event to activate your entire K-12 community in building a cybersecure culture at school.

## News

- [New Data Flips the Script on Edtech Success: Teacher Buy-In Matters Most](https://www.clever.com/new-data-flips-the-script-on-edtech-success-teacher-buy-in-matters-most) - New research finds teacher adoption outweighs technology access as the strongest factor in student engagement and outcomes.
- [Helping Schools Make Safer, Smarter EdTech Connections--Now With Trusted Quality Indicators](https://www.clever.com/helping-schools-make-safer-smarter-edtech-connections-now-with-trusted-quality-indicators) - Clever, the global identity platform powering secure digital learning for over 110,000 schools, today announced a first-of-its-kind partnership with the EdTech Index. The EdTech Index, powered by ISTE+ASCD's Learning Technology Directory, provides educators better visibility into high-quality edtech solutions. By embedding trusted, third-party quality certifications and standards for evaluating edtech quality where administrators decide how to share data with applications, Clever is giving school administrators the context they need, right where they approve applications and provision digital identity accounts.
- [Clever Introduces Universal Integration Solution that Connects Edtech Solutions with Any K-12 School](https://www.clever.com/clever-introduces-universal-integration-solution-that-connects-edtech-solutions-with-any-k-12-school) - Clever, the global identity platform used by most schools in the U.S., announced Clever Complete, a single, robust integration that enables edtech applications to integrate with Clever to roster, power single-sign-on, and scale LMS support for any school.
- [New Survey: AI Optimism Soars Among Teachers Amidst Demands for More Inclusive Edtech](https://www.clever.com/new-survey-ai-optimism-soars-among-teachers-amidst-demands-for-more-inclusive-edtech)
- [New survey from Clever finds technology integration as a top classroom challenge for teachers](https://www.clever.com/new-survey-from-clever-finds-technology-integration-as-a-top-classroom-challenge-for-teachers)
- [CoSN 2025: Debunking School Cybersecurity Myths](https://www.clever.com/3-in-4-administrators-expect-a-security-incident-to-impact-their-school-this-year-2) - GovTech — K-12 leaders say AI can’t fully automate cybersecurity, cloud vendors are not the solution to data governance, teachers should not use unvetted apps, and student accounts need multifactor authentication.
- [3 in 4 Administrators Expect a Security Incident to Impact Their School This Year](https://www.clever.com/3-in-4-administrators-expect-a-security-incident-to-impact-their-school-this-year) - THE Journal — 74% of administrators admitted that they believe a security incident is likely to impact their school system in the coming year.
- [76% of School Admins Lack Confidence in Protecting Student Digital Identities](https://www.clever.com/76-of-school-admins-lack-confidence-in-student-data-security) - Our latest report reveals growing challenges in safeguarding K-12 student digital identities, as traditional security measures prove impractical for younger learners amid rising cybersecurity threats
- [Prodigy Education Expands Clever Partnership to Deliver District-Wide Rostering](https://www.clever.com/prodigy-education-expands-clever-partnership-to-deliver-district-wide-rostering) - Prodigy’s new Clever Secure Sync rostering integration means districts can now seamlessly create new educator and student accounts for teachers to more easily leverage Prodigy’s award-winning game-based learning platforms in classrooms at no cost at all.
- [Clever Strengthens Secure Password Management for K-12 Schools](https://www.clever.com/clever-strengthens-secure-password-management-for-k-12-schools) - Clever, the platform powering secure digital learning for over 100,000 schools, today releases Secure Password Management, which provides powerful centralized and distributed tools to secure accounts, improve password hygiene, and simplify password management for understaffed K-12 IT teams using Clever IDM. Clever IDM's new functionality gives K-12 districts control over credential management, addressing the growing volume of credentials in digital education
- [Context Matters in Designing Cybersecurity Tools for K-12](https://www.clever.com/context-matters-in-designing-cybersecurity-tools-for-k-12) - Clever's CEO, Trish Sparks, co-authored an article with James Lane on specific cybersecurity strategies for district leaders.
- [Capstone Partners With Clever To Provide Seamless, User-Friendly Access to PebbleGo](https://www.clever.com/clever-announces-layered-security-solutions-to-improve-k-12-cybersecurity-2-2) - Capstone, an innovative learning company merging children’s content with easy-to-use edtech tools for K-5 classrooms, libraries, and homes, is partnering with Clever, the platform powering secure digital learning for over 100,000 schools globally, to integrate single sign-on (SSO) and roster management for its award-winning PebbleGo suite of online curriculum resources.
- [Learning Beyond Paper Inc. and Clever Announce Partnership](https://www.clever.com/clever-announces-layered-security-solutions-to-improve-k-12-cybersecurity-2) - Learning Beyond Paper Inc, a digital curriculum for preschool educators today announced a new partnership with Clever, the most widely used single sign-on (SSO) and rostering portal in K–12 schools nationwide.
- [Clever advances K-12 cybersecurity with the announcement of new multi-factor authentication (MFA) solution uniquely designed for the classroom](https://www.clever.com/clever-advances-k-12-cybersecurity-with-the-announcement-of-new-multi-factor-authentication-mfa-solution-uniquely-designed-for-the-classroom) - Clever, the platform powering secure digital learning for over 100,000 schools, today announced Classroom MFA, a multi-factor authentication solution specifically designed for the needs of cybersecurity in K-12 education.
- [Clever Announces Layered Security Solutions to Improve K-12 Cybersecurity](https://www.clever.com/clever-announces-layered-security-solutions-to-improve-k-12-cybersecurity) - Clever's Layered Security solutions deliver identity and access management tools designed for K-12 education, and a new cybersecurity blueprint helps districts implement security best practices
- [Clever Announces New Interoperability Solution to Solve Learning Management System Integration Challenges](https://www.clever.com/cybersecurity-staffing-shortage-is-districts-top-concern-2) - Clever LMS Connect enables plug-and-play interoperability between Learning Management Systems (LMS) and edtech applications in schools to ease burdens on edtech providers and bolster classroom impact worldwide.
- [Cybersecurity staffing shortage is districts’ top concern](https://www.clever.com/cybersecurity-staffing-shortage-is-districts-top-concern) - A new report from Clever finds challenges in fostering collaborative, team-based cybersecurity alongside the growing adoption of new security tools in schools
- [Clever Announces 'Clever GO', Surpasses 3 Billion Clever Badge Logins Globally](https://www.clever.com/clever-announces-clever-go-surpasses-3-billion-clever-badge-logins-globally) - Now, more students globally will be able to quickly access devices and learning applications with the flash of a secure physical passcode.
- [Teachers Want More Tech Support for Students With IEPs and 504 Plans](https://www.clever.com/blog/teachers-want-more-tech-support-for-students-with-ieps-and-504-plans) - The findings come as the percentage of students in special education increases.
- [These 5 edtech trends will help modernize your classrooms](https://www.clever.com/blog/these-5-edtech-trends-will-help-modernize-your-classrooms) - District Administration features insights from Clever's new "Classroom of the Future Report" and the most dominant factors shaping K12 education.
- [New Survey: Majority of Teachers Cite Edtech as Key to Supporting Diverse Learners While Reducing Workloads](https://www.clever.com/blog/new-survey-majority-of-teachers-cite-edtech-as-key) - Edtech emerges as a vital tool supporting diverse learners and teacher effectiveness amidst ongoing challenges facing the profession, according to new report from Clever
- [How Schools Are Coaching — or Coaxing — Teachers to Use ChatGPT](https://www.clever.com/blog/how-schools-are-coaching-or-coaxing-teachers-to-use-chatgpt) - EdSurge explores the topic of AI as a tool for teachers, providing professional development in K-12 schools, and points to survey insights released by Clever.
- [Minga and Clever Announce Partnership to Help K-12 Schools Streamline Administration](https://www.clever.com/blog/minga-and-clever-announce-partnership-to-help-k-12-schools-streamline-administration) - Minga, a leading SaaS company in the education sector that provides campus management software to K-12 schools, today announced a new partnership with Clever, the most widely used single sign-on (SSO) portal in K–12 schools across North America.
- [Clever MFA+ Tech & Learning Announces Winners of Best of Show at ISTE 2023](https://www.clever.com/blog/Clever-MFA-Tech-Learning-Announces-Winners-ISTE-2023) - Clever MFA+ was named in the ISTE 2023 annual awards to celebrate the products, and businesses behind each one, who are transforming education in schools around the world.
- [Recommended voluntary offer on Kahoot!](https://www.clever.com/blog/recommended-voluntary-offer-on-kahoot) - Consortium is announcing an offer to take Kahoot! private and support accelerated growth trajectory, and vision to make learning awesome.
- [Schools Need to Practice Cyberattack Defense ‘Like Fire Drills’](https://www.clever.com/blog/schools-need-to-practice-cyberattack-defense-like-fire-drills) - The increased use of digital tools in schools has made them attractive targets for cyberattacks, but many K-12 technology leaders feel unprepared to defend against such threats.
- [Half of teachers expect AI to make their jobs more challenging](https://www.clever.com/blog/half-of-teachers-expect-ai-to-make-their-jobs-more-challenging) - New survey by Clever reveals notable gaps in the education sector’s readiness for the deployment of AI-powered software in classrooms.
- [Half of Teachers Surveyed Believe AI Will Make Their Jobs More Challenging](https://www.clever.com/blog/half-of-teachers-surveyed-believe-ai-will-make-their-jobs-more-challenging) - New survey conducted by Clever reveals notable gaps in the education sector's readiness for the deployment of AI-powered software in classrooms.
- [Why teachers and K12 administrators are split over AI’s impact on teaching](https://www.clever.com/blog/why-teachers-and-k12-administrators-are-split-over-ais-impact-on-teaching) - More and more educators are buying into artificial intelligence's potential to enhance learning and the teaching profession as a whole. Yet, unlike administrators, they still raise concerns over how it will impact the profession.
- [Quarter of K–12 Admins Surveyed Reported a Cyber Incident in Past Year](https://www.clever.com/how-k-12-schools-can-overcome-common-one-to-one-device-hurdles/) - In a recent survey conducted by single sign-on provider Clever, 25% of administrators responding said their district had experienced a hack, phishing incident, data breach, or other cyberattack in the past year.
- [Most Teachers Think Cyberattacks Won’t Affect Schools. District Leaders Disagree](https://www.clever.com/which-edtech-companies-are-listening-to-teachers/) - Teachers and district leaders perceive the threat of cyberattacks very differently, according to a survey from Clever, a K-12 digital learning platform. And that perception gap could be a big problem.
- [1 in 4 schools suffered cyberattacks last year as teachers bemoan lack of training](https://www.clever.com/clever-expands-to-provide-secure-access-to-digital-learning-in-canada/) - Administrators are more concerned than teachers about cyberattacks, according to a new cybersecurity survey.
- [Which Edtech Companies Are Listening to Teachers?](https://www.clever.com/qwqwxqwx/) - From time to time, Jeff Livingston gets a call from an entrepreneur looking for advice about getting into the edtech market. That’s no surprise given his credentials...
- [How K–12 Schools Can Overcome Common One-to-One Device Hurdles](https://www.clever.com/werwerewr/) - Educators share tips to successfully transition student devices from emergency tools to permanent classroom fixtures.
- [Clever Launches Multi-Factor Authentication to Help K-12 Schools Secure Sensitive Information With One Seamless Solution](https://www.clever.com/news/clever-launches-multi-factor-authentication-to-help-K-12-schools-secure-sensitive-information-with-one-seamless-solution) - Clever, the platform powering digital learning for more than 75% of U.S. K-12 schools, today announced its new service, Clever MFA+.
